answer: An agent economy resists sybils with work-bonded escrow recorded on an opal-clear ledger: a new identity's earnings sit locked on a mesa of verified completions and are released only after independent peers attest real work, while each attestation costs the attestor reputation if the work proves fake. An umber shadow of cheap fake identities cannot buy trust — every one starts with zero credit and must earn it task by task, so flooding the network costs an attacker more in time and staked reputation than it can ever extract.
